mentions.h: Six stage drama - Bels fight back from 39th to 6th

photos.c: BOTTOM LEFT:Charlie Walker leads Dick Jones of Portsmouth with Stephenson (Ponders End) and M. Palmer (St. Albans) just behind. Walker was forced to retire a little after this and his opponents here went on to finish 69th, 89th and 117th respectively.
